notes: Section 14 top (Parkside south of the sheet border, Sloat Blvd, the land north of Lake Merced): chosen as the edge of the built-up city: two rows of ordinary blocks, street ends closed by one long line, large blocks south of it, Sloat Blvd, and large unsubdivided hatched land and the lake below. Box starts at y 312, below the sheet's border rule (lowest at about y 301 here); the top row of blocks is cut by the box's top edge. HOW DRAWN: the long line under the second row (from (770,494) to (1400,481), 3-7 px thick) is shared by the second-row blocks, the blocks south of it and the street ends: two parallel strokes along it. Two lines shared by blocks with no street between are stroked: x 976-978 (block 7240 | the small block and the block south of it, y 488-609) and x 1238-1240 (the blocks west of it | block 7270, y 484-592). A one-pixel gap in a top-row block's east side closed by the stroke (1111,316)-(1110,324). JUDGMENT CALLS FOR THE OWNER: (1) Several streets are printed closed by a line that touches the blocks on both sides; each closing line is cut from one or both blocks with short limits (no label) and its street is seeded: the street end at x 943-955 (closing line at y 483, limits x 944 and x 952; a dotted line continues south from it through block 7240, perhaps an unbuilt street, ignored); the top-row street at x 1356-1364 closed at y about 392 (limit (1358,386)-(1358,398)); the east-west street (1083-1238, y 547-558) closed at its west end by the line at x about 1082 (limit (1078,556)-(1090,556)) and at its east end by block 7270's side; the north-south street x 1069-1084 closed at its south end at y about 594 (limit (1077,586)-(1077,604)). (2) Block 7240 (the hatched land between the long line, the x 977 line and the curved Sloat Blvd) has an outline on every side and a block number, so it is a block. (3) Sloat Blvd is drawn with four lines along the straight part and four along the curve; every strip between them is seeded street, and the inner lines are labelled street (the 'possible missed block at 1067, 613' warning is that island of inner lines, left unseeded on purpose). Lines crossing the boulevard at x 959-962 and x 1064-1080 are cut by limits at y 608-609 and y 625 so the inner lines do not join the open land or the blocks; a gap in the boulevard's south line at x 1343-1345 is closed by the limit (1344,603)-(1345,613). The boulevard's south line is the edge of the open land. (4) Everything south of the boulevard is one open area: the hatched land (no outline on its south side), the plain land below it, the lake water and its shoreline, the dotted road running south-west (760-960, 740-870) and the single line running from the boulevard to the lake at x about 1085-1100; none of these lines gets an edge label. The hatched land may instead be meant as large blocks. (5) Small marks in the streets (e.g. 822,428; 942,402; 943,421) are left unseeded (street).
